name: Kanto Gym Gauntlet
description: Thirteen KoalaBattle-authored Kanto boss teams — the eight Gym Leaders, the Elite Four, and Champion Blue — each built as a full modern competitive squad on its trainer's theme.
mechanics_assumptions: Opponent species, order, and sets are KoalaBattle-authored around each Red/Blue trainer's specialty
Campaign battles normalize both teams to the same deterministic stage level
Event-origin minimum levels are ignored only so every legal drafted Pokemon can use that shared stage level
Every opponent set carries an explicit ability, nature, held item, EV spread, and IV spread
Roster size and set quality escalate from Brock through Champion Blue
Difficulty modes subtract levels from the player's derived stage team only; opponent levels never change
Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, and Terastallization are disabled in Challenge battles

source.variant: KoalaBattle-authored competitive teams themed on the English Red/Blue trainers; Champion Blue keeps his Charizard ace
source.compatibility_note: Teams are not the Red/Blue rosters move-for-move. Species choice and trainer identity follow the source games; the sets are authored for the Generation 9 National Dex Draft engine with legal modern abilities, natures, held items, EVs, and IVs.
